title: Project charter
description: The seven-block charter (2026-10-15 refactor). Block 1 basic identity and nature; block 2 the reducer model and hardware carrier (grease-specific, and the real starting point of a grease project); block 3 commercial intent and delivery form; block 4 the technical focus; block 5 boundaries and hard constraints; block 6 the cost CEILING; block 7 success criteria, their provisional state and the risk class. A benchmark is optional BACKGROUND only: the real comparator is built as a physical dossier at step 4, so naming one here is never a gate.

allOf.$comment: Cost is a CONSTRAINT, never a CRITERION. A charter may legitimately declare no cost target and explain why instead - on a grease project the cost is a ceiling to respect, not a target to optimise toward. target_cost stays legal when supplied (it keeps its historical meaning on the six oil routes); a grease charter records cost_ceiling and writes cost_basis_reason.

cost_ceiling.description: Optional cost ceiling: the highest unit cost the product may carry before the project is not worth doing. This is the cost semantics a precision-gear grease charter uses - a limit to respect, NOT a reduction target to optimise toward. Cost is a constraint (step 6 filter / step 14 constraint / step 16 ceiling check); it must never enter a CTQ criterion.

cost_basis_reason.description: Mandatory when target_cost is absent: why this project sets no cost target (e.g. performance-first, customer-specified price, supply-security driven). A project that declares neither a target cost nor a reason is rejected, exactly as with benchmark_waiver_reason.

benchmark_products.description: OPTIONAL background only (2026-10-15 refactor): a name or two recorded for context. It is never a gate - the comparator that matters is the physical dossier built at step 4 (REFERENCE_MATERIAL_RESOLVED), where a Known Good / Known Bad sample is docketed with its identity, storage and failure evidence. An empty or absent list is legal on every route.

benchmark_waiver_reason.description: Legacy field, kept so charters that already carry it stay valid. No longer required: since the 2026-10-15 refactor an absent benchmark needs no waiver, because a benchmark is optional background and the step-4 dossier is what a project is actually measured against.

success_criteria_status.description: Whether the success criteria are settled or still provisional. PROVISIONAL is legal and expected at charter time: a precision-gear grease project often starts before the customer's machine-level thresholds are agreed, and recording that honestly is better than inventing a number. Step 3 (FAILURE_MECHANISM_DEFINED) refines them; a provisional set must be re-visited there rather than silently treated as final.

reducer_model.description: Block 2: the hardware the grease is developed for. This is a grease project's real starting point - the duty, the materials and the geometry all follow from it.

model_size.description: Reducer frame size (谐波减速器机型规格).

reduction_ratio.description: Reduction ratio as the OEM states it, e.g. '100:1'.

structure_form.description: Structure form: 杯形 (CUP) / 礼帽形 (HAT) / 超扁平 (ULTRA_FLAT).

friction_pair_materials.description: Friction-pair materials, e.g. 柔轮 flexspline / 刚轮 circular spline, with their surface treatment.

surface_treatment.description: Surface treatment of the friction pair, including whether a DLC coating is present.

delivery_form.description: Block 3: the delivery form and batch magnitude - LAB is 500 g to 2 kg, PILOT is 20 to 50 kg, PRODUCTION is tonne-scale.

cost_position.description: Block 6: the cost posture. CEILING is the only legal value on a precision-gear grease charter: fill volume is 10 to 50 g per unit, performance and life come first, and no active cost-reduction target is set. The cost still appears as a filter at step 6, a constraint at step 14 and a ceiling check at step 16, and it never enters a CTQ.
